units.title: Regression, variance and distributions
units.why: Statistical summaries help assess variation and relationships in data.
principles: standard deviation measures typical distance from mean
examples: A dataset with larger spread has larger standard deviation
A positive correlation means variables tend to increase together
misconceptions: treating correlation as proof of cause

videoPackage.title: Reading spread and relationships
videoPackage.transcript: We describe spread numerically, read relationships from plots, and avoid claiming causation from correlation alone.
